skill.name: verification-before-completion
skill.description: Requires fresh verification evidence before claiming software work is complete, fixed, passing, or ready to ship.
skill.summary: Run and read verification evidence before making completion claims.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

content.value_statement: Software agents can overstate completion before tests, builds, or requirements are checked. This skill makes evidence mandatory before any success claim.
actual_capabilities: Requires fresh verification evidence before completion, fix, or passing claims.
Guides the agent to identify, run, read, and confirm verification output.
Flags weak claims such as should pass, probably fixed, and looks correct.
Covers tests, linters, builds, regression checks, requirements, and agent delegation.
Encourages reporting actual status and gaps when verification does not pass.
limitations: Does not choose project-specific commands without repository context.
Does not make unsafe commands acceptable without user approval.
Cannot guarantee external tools, tests, or services are available.
Depends on the agent reading full output and exit status carefully.

use_cases.title: Confirm Pull Request Readiness
use_cases.description: Run the relevant checks and report evidence before saying a branch is ready for review.

use_cases.title: Verify Delegated Agent Work
use_cases.description: Check diffs, requirements, and test output before accepting another agent completion report.

use_cases.title: Validate Bug Fixes
use_cases.description: Confirm the original failure path and related regression checks before claiming a fix works.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Completion Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before saying a task is done.
prompt_templates.prompt: Before you claim completion, identify the verification needed, run it, read the output, and report the evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build And Test Evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a commit or pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this change with the relevant test and build checks. Report exact pass, fail, or blocked status with evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Requirement Checklist Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a task has multiple acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-read the requirements, create a checklist, verify each item, and state any gaps before claiming the work is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Regression Confidence Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for bug fixes that need stronger proof.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply regression verification for the original symptom. Confirm the failure path, the fixed path, and the final status with evidence.

output_examples.input: Can you confirm this change is ready to merge?
output_examples.output: I ran the project checks and read the full output. Tests passed, the build passed, and no verification gaps remain.
I cannot claim the bug is fixed yet. The regression check still fails, so the current status is incomplete.

output_examples.input: The helper agent said everything succeeded. Are we done?
output_examples.output: I reviewed the diff and verified the relevant checks myself. The implementation matches the requirements and the checks passed.

best_practices: Run verification in the current session before making success claims.
Read full output, exit status, and failure counts before summarizing results.
Report partial progress honestly when any verification step is missing or failing.
anti_patterns: Claiming work is done because the code looks correct.
Using old test output as proof for a new change.
Accepting another agent success report without independent verification.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It prevents agents from claiming success before tests, builds, requirements, or delegated work are verified.

faq.question: Does it run a specific test command?
faq.answer: No. It tells the agent to identify the correct verification command for the current project.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written as general workflow guidance for all three supported tools.

faq.question: Does it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. It improves evidence quality before review, but humans still decide whether the work is acceptable.

faq.question: What happens when verification fails?
faq.answer: The agent should report the actual failing status and avoid any completion claim.

faq.question: Is this only for tests?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to builds, linters, requirements, bug fixes, and delegated agent reports.
